author_layer.promotion_record: Promotion predates this full-library verification turn. This verifier audit did not promote or modify formal runtime files.

preserved_contracts: PHASES and VIEWS with all four authored views
visible rotor plus spinning and stationary validation probes
public API: play, reset, seek, goToView, dispose, getState
camera tween, orbit, zoom, keyboard controls, fallback and teardown

tests.name: pre-promotion formal archive immutability
tests.evidence: All four formal author/test SHA256 values still match baseline/author-files.sha256.

tests.name: module syntax
tests.evidence: node --check passed for both candidate modules.

tests.name: original and candidate physics suites
tests.evidence: Both suites passed with identical 240 Hz, body/joint, inertia, analytic, simulated and three-run deterministic results. Candidate additionally checks the outer ROTOR_PARTS object and every public part are frozen and reject mutation.

tests.name: fixed-state API equivalence
tests.evidence: Baseline and candidate getState() were deeply equal at steps 0, 180, 660, 840, 1008 and 1128 and for independent, nested, axes and exploded views.

tests.name: fixed-state pixel equivalence
tests.evidence: Matched baseline/candidate pairs for default, t000, t075, t275, t350, t420, t470, nested, axes and exploded all measured RGB AE=0.

tests.name: axes capture repeatability qualification
tests.evidence: An early axes pair measured AE=1637. Fresh-context investigation measured baseline self-repeat AE=1447, while a matched fresh-context baseline/candidate pair measured AE=0; the standard final axes pair also measures AE=0. The mismatch was Chromium font-raster nondeterminism in baseline capture, not candidate geometry, materials, ordering or state. Arbitrary independent screenshots are therefore not claimed bit-identical.

tests.name: viewport coverage
tests.evidence: 1600x900 and 1280x720 baseline/candidate default pairs measured AE=0 with the stage contained in the viewport.

tests.name: interaction and reset
tests.evidence: Number and arrow view selection, space play/pause/resume, view switching during playback, camera-tween interruption, orbit, zoom and keyboard reset passed. After a stable capture, orbit/zoom changed the frame and reset restored it with AE=0 and canonical final state.

tests.name: pointer-capture loss boundary
tests.evidence: pointercancel and lostpointercapture both route through pointerUp/stopDragging. A real pointerdown followed by synthetic lostpointercapture changed dragging true to false; a subsequent drag started and ended normally.

tests.name: reduced motion
tests.evidence: At 1280x720 with reduced motion, view changes do not tween and play resolves to settled final state. Baseline/candidate reduced-motion screenshots measured AE=0.

tests.name: dependency and WebGL failures
tests.evidence: Three, Rapier and WebGL failure paths exposed the fallback, hid loading and did not leave a live API. Baseline/candidate Three and Rapier fallback screenshots measured AE=0.

tests.name: dispose and reinitialize
tests.evidence: dispose cancels work/listeners, removes window.__gimbalPage and releases renderer/physics resources; reload creates exactly one canvas and a fresh working API.

independent_review.coverage: Final metrics, four instant views, invalid view, play-time view change, double-reset idempotence, pointer-capture loss, dispose/reload, and 1280 reduced motion.

risks.risk: Chromium can rasterize the axes label differently across otherwise identical fresh baseline contexts.
risks.mitigation: Judge paired captures made with fonts.ready and identical state; matched baseline/candidate axes pairs are AE=0.

risks.risk: The staging candidate depends on the formal archive asset tree through a relative symlink.
risks.mitigation: The link target is recorded and verified; promotion must copy or deliberately preserve the same asset layout.

risks.risk: Refactoring shared lifecycle and presentation paths could alter edge-state transitions.
risks.mitigation: The acceptance matrix covers play/pause, tween interruption, reset idempotence, lost pointer capture, reduced motion, fallback and teardown.

notes: The candidate was promoted after passing the full audit and receiving user approval.
Physics parameters, geometry values and transparent housing mesh insertion order remain baseline-equivalent.
